judge_verdict.reasons_for_rejection: The evaluation plan contains a critical logical flaw in expert selection and coverage. Specifically, the `topology_boundary_auditor` is assigned to audit the 'secondary sea lion' without a preceding localization step by the `open_vocabulary_detector`. The topology auditor requires precise segmentation masks which depend on bounding box priors; assigning it directly to a specific instance without detection is technically invalid. Furthermore, the plan fails to explicitly verify the anatomical integrity (limb count/structure) of the main subject using the `animal_pose_auditor`, relying instead on general perceptual quality checks which may miss subtle structural deformities common in AI generation.
